---
title: "NHANES Dashboard"
author: "G Crawford-Gee"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output:
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: rows
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)

# load packages
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(flexdashboard)

# Load cleaned NHANES data
cleaned_NHANES <- read_csv(
  here("cleaned_NHANES.csv")
)

# Calculate percentage of participants aged 21 or older
percent_21_plus <- cleaned_NHANES %>%
  summarise(
    percentage = mean(age >= 21, na.rm = TRUE) * 100
  ) %>%
  pull(percentage)

# Create average systolic blood pressure
cleaned_NHANES <- cleaned_NHANES %>%
  mutate(
    avg_sbp = rowMeans(
      select(
        .,
        systolic_bp_1,
        systolic_bp_2,
        systolic_bp_3,
        systolic_bp_4
      ),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    avg_sbp = ifelse(
      is.nan(avg_sbp),
      NA,
      avg_sbp
    )
  )

# Calculate percentage of participants whose average SBP is greater than 120 mm Hg
percent_sbp_120 <- cleaned_NHANES %>%
  summarise(
    percentage = mean(avg_sbp > 120, na.rm = TRUE) * 100
  ) %>%
  pull(percentage)

```

Row {data-height=650}
---------------------------------

### Age Distribution

```{r age, echo = FALSE}
knitr::include_graphics(
  here("figures", "3.1-age-distribution.PNG")
)
```


Row {data-height=350}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Percentage of Participants Aged 21 or Older

```{r percent-age, echo=FALSE}
gauge(
  round(percent_21_plus, 1),
  min = 0,
  max = 100,
  sectors = gaugeSectors(
    success = c(75, 100),
    warning = c(50, 75),
    danger = c(0, 50)
  )
)
```


### Participants with Average SBP over 120 mm Hg

```{r sbp120, echo=FALSE}
valueBox(
  paste0(
    round(percent_sbp_120, 1),
    "%"
  ),
  caption = "Average SBP above 120 mm Hg",
  color = "info"
)
```
